author: Cburnett (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/User:Cburnett)
license_choice: Each file page carries {{self|GFDL|migration=relicense|BSD|GPL}} with author {{U|Cburnett}}: the author's own release under a license of the user's choice. Cburnett added the BSD option himself on 2007-01-12. Checkmate uses BSD.
revisions: Only Cburnett's own last upload of each file (2007-01-03) is used; later uploads by other users are not. Archive URL pattern: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/archive/<hash path>/<superseded timestamp>!Chess_<piece>45.svg
evidence: Each file's SHA-1 equals the SHA-1 that the Commons API (prop=imageinfo&iiprop=user|timestamp|sha1) reports for Cburnett's 2007-01-03 revision.
adaptations: The path data and styles are transcribed into Sources/CheckmateNative/PieceArtwork.swift and drawn natively; white and black take the board palette's piece colours. PieceArtworkTests checks the transcription against these files.
